[[File:BruceCassidy2026.jpg|thumb|upright|[[Bruce Cassidy]] led the Golden Knights to a [[Stanley Cup]] championship in his first season as head coach.]]
The [[Vegas Golden Knights]] are an American professional [[ice hockey]] team based in the [[Las Vegas Valley|Las Vegas metropolitan area]]. They play in the [[Pacific Division (NHL)|Pacific Division]] of the [[Western Conference (NHL)|Western Conference]] in the [[National Hockey League]] (NHL). They have played at [[T-Mobile Arena]] since their inaugural season in [[2017–18 NHL season|2017–18]]. The Golden Knights joined the NHL as an [[expansion team]] in 2017. The team's first head coach, [[Gerard Gallant]], was hired on April 13, 2017.<ref>{{cite web |title=Golden Knights Name Gerard Gallant Head Coach |url=https://www.nhl.com/goldenknights/news/golden-knights-name-gerard-gallant-head-coach-288743770 |website=NHL.com |access-date=April 13, 2017 |date=April 13, 2017}}</ref> Gallant was fired on January 15, 2020, and replaced by recently fired [[San Jose Sharks]] head coach [[Peter DeBoer]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Vegas Golden Knights Make Coaching Changes; Name Peter DeBoer Head Coach |url=https://www.nhl.com/goldenknights/news/vegas-golden-knights-make-coaching-changes-name-peter-deboer-head-coac-313969764 |website=NHL.com |access-date=January 15, 2020 |date=January 15, 2020}}</ref> DeBoer served as head coach until his firing on May 16, 2022.<ref>{{cite web |title=Vegas Golden Knights Announce Changes To Coaching Staff |url=https://www.nhl.com/goldenknights/news/vegas-golden-knights-announce-changes-to-coaching-staff-334120726 |website=NHL.com |access-date=May 16, 2022 |date=May 16, 2022}}</ref> Former [[Boston Bruins]] head coach [[Bruce Cassidy]] was named the team’s third head coach on June 14, 2022.<ref>{{cite web |title=Vegas Golden Knights Name Bruce Cassidy as Team's Head Coach |url=https://www.nhl.com/goldenknights/news/vegas-golden-knights-name-bruce-cassidy-as-team-s-head-coach-334605588 |website=NHL.com |access-date=June 14, 2022 |date=June 14, 2022}}</ref> Cassidy was subsequently fired on March 29, 2026, with [[John Tortorella]] named the team's fourth head coach.<ref>{{cite web| title= Cassidy fired as Golden Knights coach, replaced by Tortorella |url= https://www.nhl.com/news/john-tortorella-hired-as-vegas-golden-knights-coach-after-bruce-cassidy-fired |access-date=March 29, 2026 |date= March 29, 2026}}</ref> On June 16, 2026, following the conclusion of the [[2026 Stanley Cup Final]], the team announced that Tortorella would not return as head coach.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nhl.com/news/john-tortorella-wont-return-as-vegas-golden-knights-coach |title=Tortorella won't return as Golden Knights coach |access-date=June 16, 2026 |website=NHL.com |date=June 16, 2026}}</ref> One day later, former assistant coach and [[Henderson Silver Knights]] head coach [[Ryan Craig]] was named the fifth head coach in franchise history.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.nhl.com/news/ryan-craig-named-coach-of-vegas-golden-knights |title=Craig named coach of Golden Knights, replaces Tortorella |website=NHL.com |date=June 17, 2026 |access-date=June 17, 2026}}</ref>
